Subject: Supplier compliance intake & PO readiness — next steps and required docs

Hi Emily —

Welcome and thanks again for choosing Redwood for the integration pilot. To get the vendor record created and the PO issued, procurement needs a short packet from your team. Below is the intake checklist we need to complete before Finance can activate payments and issue PO RED-0003429: 

Required (please return as attachments or via the DocuSign link):
- Completed W-9 (US vendors) OR W-8BEN-E (non-US) — signed and dated
- VAT registration certificate (if applicable) or VAT exemption docs
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached Excel) with legal name, remit address, tax ID/EIN, and bank routing info (ACH preferred)

Optional but helpful:
- Brief statement of data handling if any PII will be transmitted (one paragraph)
- Contact for invoice submission and AP email address

Logistics / timing: we typically create the vendor record within 1–2 business days of receiving all docs. Once the vendor is active, we’ll issue the PO within 24 hours. Payment terms are Net30 by default; if you need alternative terms, flag that in your reply.

I’ve attached the onboarding form and a draft PO for reference. If you prefer to send via DocuSign, here’s the link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-hexaservices-po

Can you confirm which tax form you’ll provide and an estimated ETA for the packet?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Sooyun (Soojin) Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9 and onboarding form. Short answers to your questions:
- You can upload VAT documentation later if and when you issue EU invoices; it is not strictly required to create the initial US vendor record. However, if Hexa anticipates regular EU billing, sharing VAT cert now speeds regional tax setup and avoids future payment holds.
- We still need the bank details (ACH) to set up direct deposit before the first payment — a scanned bank letter or bank account verification stub works.

Action items from our side: we’ll intake the W-9 and vendor form into the system today. Soojin will confirm vendor record creation and PO issuance once Finance confirms bank details.

-Marcus
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
